## Checklist

- [ ] `flutter gen-l10n` run if any ARB file changed
- [ ] `dart format lib/ test/` run
- [ ] `flutter analyze` prints `No issues found!`
- [ ] `flutter test --coverage` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the behavior, including failure paths
- [ ] New strings added to the ARB files (no hardcoded English)
- [ ] Accessibility checked: labels, 48dp targets, text scaling, reduce motion
- [ ] No new network, analytics or account dependency
- [ ] User data is preserved (migration plus fixture test if a model changed)
- [ ] No `// ignore:` added to silence a lint
